title: relay_client.rs: multi-line greeting responses cause protocol desync
description: relay_client.rs run_smtp_session: the 220 greeting is read as a single line (read_line). RFC 5321 §4.2 permits multi-line responses (e.g. '220-banner\r\n220 ready\r\n'). If the server sends a multi-line 220 banner (e.g. sendmail, qmail), the client reads only the first continuation line and then sends EHLO. The second line of the greeting is then read as the EHLO response, causing parse_smtp_line to receive '220 ready' instead of a 250 response, triggering a Permanent error. The EHLO response handler correctly drains multi-line responses but the greeting does not. Note: multi-line 220 is rare in practice but valid per RFC 5321.
